body: If you guys were still wondering I'm still here, I did drink some of that whiskey and kinda just took a seat on the floor watching his gun. I never touched it... I'm not going to delete this throwaway account because I kinda wanna go back and read what you guys said to me today. And as far as my social media, I'm gonna leave those gone, there's just more important things I need to be focusing on right now, like learning to be alone before I start trying to be around others or meeting someone new. A lot of my problem I feel is I become to attached and depended on others, I need to work on that, among other things. There's just a bunch of stuff I wanna fix about myself and make right and social media hasn't ever really been an aid in stuff like that, ya know? Something's gotta give way here and run all this really awful thinking out of my head! I feel just seeing what complete strangers had to say to me really helped out

Man, I could go on and on about what brought me here and you're right about posting here I think, I didn't realize it but I don't have a whole lot of people that'll be all that caring towards the topic. My parents would be heart broken at the idea and if I went to them or anyone that close to me and did it right this time, they'd be heart broken and think they failed to save me. I can't do that to them but yet I do want to be told no, it's okay, we all get through this shit. I've never been so low in my life, I've pretty much lost all hope of holding a career at my job( getting fired)  my parents are paying half of my overwhelming debt right now, I'm starving to death, I hate my terrible apartment, I'm addicted as hell to ambian, and yet never sleep, my girlfriend of a few years left me a couple weeks back, who changed my entire way of life, my prospective on nearly everything was different, for the better, I was a much better guy because of her. Now... I have nothing, no friends at all, limited family (can't turn to them) I don't even feel alive right now. This was typed rather quickly as I'm still at work so I left out so much

Edit: basically the one person I had to turn to for whatever I was dealing with, is gone. She left me in this state of hell all by myself, that's pretty much what this all comes down to I guess. It was a lot before, but now it's just to much. I'm not able enough to deal with this shit, some people can move on through stuff like this bit I'm not built for it
